title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: In the Claude app's sidebar, open the two sessions "LEDGER: read back page answers (nightly)" and "LEDGER: fresh-session test (once)"; where either waits on a permission question, choose to always allow it; where one shows no question, press Stop.
sections.recommendation: Allow: both only read (your page answers; the project's files). A scheduled session stops at its first question with nobody there, which has blocked the nightly read-back since 26 October; an answer given once is kept for its later runs. There is no web link for a session; both are in the app's sidebar.
